state.paragraph: Between September 24, 2013 and September 27, 2013, Kirkland and outside counsel to Mr. MacDonald negotiated the terms of the MacDonald voting agreements, which were entered into by Mr. MacDonald, his wife and one of his trusts on September 27, 2013, and which became effective upon entry into the merger agreement.

ledger_rows.Note: Executed with CSC and Pamplona until 5 p.m. ET 10/12/2013; included $15M CSC reverse termination fee and no financing contingency; Pamplona funding 100%.
After Moab and Pamplona held rollover discussions, the Special Committee was told Moab would not roll over any shares in the transaction.

agreements.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a voting, support or rollover agreement, a special committee, or the merger agreement itself is formed, approved or signed. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
